description_en:
Checks whether SQL audit logs of a specified database instance have been successfully connected to Simple Log Service (SLS).
After the call, the system returns the connection status between the SQL audit feature and SLS for the current instance, the project and Logstore configuration information, and whether synchronization is normal
description_zh:
该接口用于检查指定数据库实例的 SQL 审计日志是否已成功接入 SLS（阿里云日志服务，Log Service）。
调用后，系统返回当前实例的 SQL 审计功能与 SLS 的连接状态、项目（Project）和日志库（Logstore）配置信息、同步是否正常等
name: CheckSqlAuditSlsStatus

parameters.help_en: The region in which the instance resides. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id
parameters.name: region_id

Status.description_en:
The enabling status of the SQL audit feature. Valid values:
enabled: The feature is enabled.
disabled: The feature is disabled
Status.description_zh: sql审计功能开启状态，取值范围如下：enabled：已开启disabled：未开启
